title: SCIM group names are limited to an operator-defined set of grantable roles, and SCIM cannot deactivate the last enabled admin

criteria.given: a SCIM group created or renamed to ROLE_SQL_EXEC, ROLE_TOKEN_PRINCIPAL, ROLE_EMBED_AUTHOR, a guest role (ROLE_EMBED_GUEST / ROLE_SHARE_GUEST), ROLE_ANONYMOUS, ROLE_SCIM, ROLE_ACTUATOR or any role in userService.getAdminRoles()
criteria.then: ScimService answers 400 invalidValue — the reserved set is computed (admin roles come from getAdminRoles(), never a hard-coded ROLE_ADMIN literal) and is enforced on every displayName entry point (create, PUT replace, PATCH rename)

only roles on that allow-list can be granted through SCIM groups; a name outside it answers 400 invalidValue; the reserved roles stay refused even if listed; the default (everything not reserved) is documented in docs/operator-hardening.md and the property is wired in saiku-beans.xml

criteria.given: the only enabled account holding an admin role (per userService.getAdminRoles())
criteria.then: SCIM cannot deactivate it — DELETE /Users/{id}, PATCH active:false and PUT with active:false all answer 400; with a second enabled admin present, deactivating one succeeds

criteria.given: the regression suite for the list and the last-admin rule
criteria.then: ScimServiceTest covers the reserved set (including ROLE_SQL_EXEC and a case variant), the allow-list behaviour and the last-enabled-admin guard on all three deactivation paths
